ios.desc:
Wordmazing is a relaxing word game and vocabulary builder in one! Master 2,600+ GRE & GMAT vocabulary words while playing one of the most relaxing word game ever created.

Guess the secret word given a clue, its first letter, and length. Swipe the grid starting at the blue tile to spell the word.  If your guess is a valid word but not the answer, incorrect letters will disappear from the grid.

Wordmazing includes a vocabulary review tool that shows all previously completed words and their short definitions. 

► Relax and play the game at your own pace with unlimited tries. 
► You can tap the green lightbulb for more letter clues if you get stuck. 
► Levels are divided into 3 difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, and Hard. 
► In addition to the 2601 levels, there is a daily challenge level with a reward if completed. 

Are you up for the challenge? Play Wordmazing once a day to keep your mind sharp and expand your vocabulary!

Keywords: GRE vocab words, vocab builder, vocab puzzle, vocab builder game
